api.name: get_trade_call
api.description: Returns a composite verdict — BUY SELL HOLD trade call with confidence and market regime — for one crypto or tokenized-stock perpetual futures. One asset only; whole-market scan: scan_trade_calls. Read-only: live exchange APIs, no orders. Verified track record: get_track_record or performance://signal-performance; on-chain verified merkle anchor.

coin.description: Asset — BTC ETH SOL signal for crypto perpetual futures or TradFi symbol.

timeframe.description: Candle timeframe (1m to 1d) for crypto quant agents. Default 15m intraday.

includeReasoning.description: Include reasoning for the trade call verdict (regime, trend ranging signals).

api.description: Returns the market regime — TRENDING_UP TRENDING_DOWN RANGING VOLATILE — with confidence and a strategy hint, for one crypto perpetual futures. Composite verdict: trend ranging + cross-venue funding rate. Read-only, live exchange APIs. Verified track record: get_track_record or performance://signal-performance; on-chain verified merkle anchor.

api.name: search_knowledge
api.description: Returns ranked snippets from the AlgoVault knowledge bundle answering a question about its MCP tools, response shapes, integration patterns (LangChain, LlamaIndex, MAF, CrewAI), or code examples. Call this BEFORE other tool calls to confirm parameter usage and avoid hallucinating tool shapes. Fast: BM25 lexical search, no LLM call, no quota cost. For a synthesized natural-language answer use chat_knowledge. Read-only, no side effects.

api.name: chat_knowledge
api.description: Returns a synthesized natural-language answer with citations, grounded in the AlgoVault knowledge bundle (every MCP tool description, response shape, integration tutorial, and code example). Use when you need an explanation, code pattern, or how-to; for raw ranked snippets without LLM synthesis use search_knowledge (faster, no quota cost). Read-only: calls an LLM, no other side effects. Quota: Free 10/month, Starter 50, Pro 200, Enterprise 2000.

api.name: scan_trade_calls
api.description: Returns ranked BUY SELL HOLD trade calls across the top crypto perpetual futures by open interest — one scan for whole-market coverage, each with confidence and market regime. Use this for breadth; use get_trade_call for per-coin depth and reasoning. Read-only: reads live exchange APIs, places no orders.

topN.description: Scan the top-N perps by open interest (1-100, default 20). Whole-market scan.

timeframe.description: Candle timeframe (1m to 1d) for the scan. Default 15m intraday.

exchange.description: Venue: BINANCE (default) HL BYBIT OKX BITGET — top perps by open interest.

minConfidence.description: Optional min confidence (0-100) filter applied to non-HOLD trade calls.

includeHolds.description: Include HOLD calls after non-HOLD (default false).

limit.description: Max ranked calls returned (1-100, default 10). Non-HOLD ranked first.
